name: ESET Remote Administrator
reason: The only ESET cask is ESET Cyber Security (antivirus); its Team ID would deny the antivirus, not the remote administrator.

name: Parallels Access
reason: The Parallels casks are Parallels Desktop and its tools; the shared Team ID would deny the virtualisation product.

name: JumpCloud
reason: The only JumpCloud cask is the password manager, not the device agent; its Team ID would deny the password manager on every Mac.
